notes.title: Reviews Roulette: The one with Donkey Kong's wooden nipples
notes.notes:
Reviews Roulette is where the RPS video department attempt to review all the random game keys that arrive unsolicited in their inbox. The hunt for hidden gems begins!

Did you know Rock Paper Shotgun have an absolutely phenomenal, world-class video department? No? Well, you do now. And this knowledge comes from me, Alice L, one of the three members of said world-class video department, so you can guarantee that praise is true and unbiased in every way. Something we put together on an infrequent basis is Reviews Roulette. It’s infrequent because it’s no easy thing being a YouTuber. There are so many apology videos, rants, and call-out vids to do, it’s hard to schedule the fun things more regularly.

Reviews Roulette is where the RPS video team take a selection of random review keys we’ve been sent, play them for ten minutes, and decide if we want to play them for longer. If they really catch our eye, they’ll get the esteemed Daddy Wallace award. For context, please refer to this episode.

notes.title: Mr Boom's Firework Factory Prepared for release!
notes.notes:
It is with great happiness that I am announcing [b]Mr Boom's Firework Factory[/b] is finally ready for general consumption and as of [b]19:00 BST on the 10th of July 2019[/b] will officially [b]leave beta[/b]!

[h1]So what does this really mean?[/h1]

I've been working extremely hard on getting everything rounded off these past six months, most notably the past three weeks where I've been working non-stop on getting everything just right for you.

[h1]What's changed?[/h1]

Amongst other smaller things, the most important changes in this release are:

[list]
[*] All 30 levels are now in the game!
[*] The end screen is in the game - reach it if you can!
[*] All issues reported in pre-release reviews have been addressed
[*] The game's achievements are now live and will be obtainable the minute the game is released. There are a few of these and 30 of them are hidden. Have fun achieving them all!
[/list]

[h1]What if i need support with the game?[/h1]

If you require support with the game upon release, or if you just want a place to hang out and discuss the game, strategies, plot etc, then feel free to join me, the developer of the game, on the [url=https://discord.gg/brainbox]official discord server for the game[/url]! You can also follow [url=https://twitter.com/brainboxdotcc]@brainboxdotcc[/url] on twitter for up-to-the-minute updates.

[h1]Finally, a huge thank-you![/h1]

I'd like to thank all the testers, die-hard fans, and everyone else that helped make this project a reality and supported me throughout these past years, it's been a long road, and we're finally here!

[b]STAY TUNED TO THIS CHANNEL![/b]

notes.title: Mr Boom's Firework Factory selected as an Indie Prize Finalist!
notes.notes:
I'm really happy to announce that [b]Mr Boom's Firework Factory[/b] has been selected as an [b]Indie Prize finalist[/b] and I will be attending
[b]Casual Connect London 2019 on 28th-30th May[/b] where I will be exhibiting my game in the QEII Centre on the third floor.

Come along and say hi, or have a go at my game in person!

There will be a live stream during the event.

I look forwards to seeing you there!

notes.title: Mr Boom's Firework Factory Beta 2019-02-23 released
notes.notes:
Today's beta version includes a full and complete version of [b]level 7[/b].
It is now decorated, and has the [b]fully active robot[/b] which will attempt to catch and weld your crates. He now has a[b] voice[/b]!!!

[u][b]Bugs fixed in this version:[/b][/u]

* [i]Some conveyor junctions did not respond[/i] to clicks on level 6 in the rightmost conveyor nearest the goop pool
*  Machines situated at the rear of the warehouse near the window were [i]difficult to click on when placing wrenches[/i], this has been fixed.

As always please let me know [url=https://discord.gg/MSU6XXK]on Discord[/url] if you have any issues running this beta! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: 21st Feb 2019 Update Notes
notes.notes:
The latest update for Mr Boom's Firework Factory for Beta Testing has one major fix and one enhancement.

The bug which stops you interacting with the game after continuing from the pause menu is now fixed.

As for enhancements, level 7 with the malfunctioning robot is here! This level is incomplete in terms of assets and appearance, but if you're quick you may be able to complete it and it's layout is correct and finished.

If you have any questions, please use discord or comment here!

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: 19th Feb 2019 Update Notes
notes.notes:
The 19th February update adds level six to the game.

If you have any issues with completing this game during the beta test please join the discord server for assistance.

notes.title: Mr Boom's Firework Factory now has a Discord server!
notes.notes:
If you want to follow the development and testing of this game, please [url=https://discord.gg/MSU6XXK]join our discord server[/url].

As well as being the central place for the beta testers involved in the closed beta to join and have a chat or discuss the game, it is also a good place to find developers, and ask for further information.

Why not come along, you might find something interesting!

notes.title: Get involved in the beta!
notes.notes:
If you want to get involved in the beta testing of this game, please join our discord! Our discord is a great place to discuss the game, get involved in the beta test and offer feedback, or even speak to us directly about the game. To join, please follow the link below:

https://discord.gg/MSU6XXK

[b]We are still looking for beta testers[/b], and we are looking for people who are excited to get involved before our release in July. [b]All beta testers will be credited in the game's credits screen and will be able to keep their copy of the game at the end of the beta test[/b].

Each week there will be updates to the game copy with new levels, fixes, tweaks as people suggest changes. 

There are limited spaces for testers, so please join the discord ASAP and message me (Brain) to get involved!

notes.title: Closed Beta
notes.notes:
If you want to take part in a closed beta of this game (or any future versions going forward), please get in touch by messaging me, or replying to this group thread.

I am looking for people who will try out the levels and features of the game and suggest improvements and/or find bugs.

All who take part will be credited in the game credits as testers!
